claim.text: RoPE rotates each absolute position, and the attention score depends only on the relative distance between the tokens.

spec.explain: Toy illustration of arXiv 2104.09864 rope rotation: the dial turns by relative distance, bounded by absolute positions rotating together.

questions.q: Predict what m = 7 does to the dial before moving it?
Does n = 3 mean absolute position n is ignored, before moving n?
What happens to the shared rotation when theta = 0.8 is set?
Why does m = 2 with n = 8 give the same gap as shifted pairs?

} ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); var cx = w * 0.3; var cy = h * 0.52; var r = h * 0.32; var cx2 = w * 0.76; var cy2 = h * 0.52; var r2 = h * 0.22; var i = 0; var a = 0; var tx = 0; var ty = 0; ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2, cy2, r2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeStyle = "#9aa3b2"; ctx.beginPath(); for (i = 0; i < 12; i = i + 1) { a = i * Math.PI / 6; tx = cx + Math.cos(a) * r; ty = cy + Math.sin(a) * r; ctx.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (r - 8), cy + Math.sin(a) * (r - 8)); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty); } ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) { a = i * Math.PI / 4; ctx.moveTo(cx2 + Math.cos(a) * (r2 - 6), cy2 + Math.sin(a) * (r2 - 6)); ctx.lineTo(cx2 + Math.cos(a) * r2, cy2 + Math.sin(a) * r2); } ctx.stroke(); var aM = -m * th; var aN = -n * th; var lo = Math.min(aM, aN); var hi = Math.max(aM, aN); ctx.strokeStyle = "#c46a1b"; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r * 0.55, lo, hi); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(aM) * r, cy + Math.sin(aM) * r); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#c46a1b"; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(aN) * r, cy + Math.sin(aN) * r); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + Math.cos(aM) * r, cy + Math.sin(aM) * r, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#c46a1b"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + Math.cos(aN) * r, cy + Math.sin(aN) * r, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#111111"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2, cy2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#0e7a3d"; ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx2, cy2); ctx.lineTo(cx2 + Math.cos(-ang) * r2, cy2 + Math.sin(-ang) * r2); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#111111"; ctx.font = "14px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillText("m vector blue", cx - r, cy + r + 28); ctx.fillText("n vector orange", cx - r, cy + r + 48); ctx.fillText("rel dial green", cx2 - r2 - 10, cy2 + r2 + 28); ctx.font = "15px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("rel = " + fmt(rel), 48, 318); ctx.fillText("ang = " + fmt(ang), 220, 318); ctx.fillText("m = 7 shifts blue needle", 380, 318); }
